paragraphs.text: Artifacts known as Onulets were artificial creatures created by Tocasia based on old Thran designs she found in the Great Desert .

As Onulets had no need for sleep or food and could haul heavy pieces of equipment, they were greatly appreciated as beasts of burden by the diggers at Tocasia's dig site. Resembling large oxen , they almost had the look of real biological animals, and several of Tocasia's students had thought them to be so; however, their knee joints and stiff gait revealed them to be artifact creatures to those using enough scrutiny.
